answer: Charge a refundable shale bond for every new identity and release it only after a month of steady, verified activity. A sybil operator must lock real money behind each fake account, so the cost scales with the size of the army. Behaviour is checked against a public gale of recent work, and accounts that copy each other get a anchor freeze until a human reviewer clears them. One honest agent pays one small bond; a thousand fakes pay a thousand.
